message.content: Based on the information provided in the sources, Li Hua did not explicitly mention preparing all the delicious food for tonight's Chinese Lunar New Year before Wolfgang Schulz wished him a happy Lunar New Year. In the messages shared, Wolfgang Schulz only mentioned his plans to enjoy good food and relax during the celebration. However, Li Hua did express excitement about cooking traditional dishes and possibly getting some decorations set up for the Lunar New Year festivities, indicating that he had some preparations underway. This suggests that Wolfgang Schulz likely wished Li Hua a happy Lunar New Year after Li Hua had already started planning and setting up for the celebration, rather than before Wolfgang made his wish.
